description: Create a new Cloud Hadoop cluster. HA is mandatory and not configurable: always 2 master nodes and 1 edge node. Pass cloudHadoopImageProductCode explicitly — it defaults to the latest image, but the related lookups (ncloud_hadoop_list_cluster_types / _list_addons / _list_products / _list_target_subnets) all require it, so the values you pick must come from the same image. Use dryRun=true to preview.

cloudHadoopAddOnCodeList.description: Add-on codes (from ncloud_hadoop_list_addons, e.g. PRESTO, HBASE)

cloudHadoopAdminUserName.description: Ambari admin user name (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, '-'; starts with a letter)

cloudHadoopAdminUserPassword.description: Admin password: 8-20 chars (9-20 in the Government zone) mixing letters, numbers and special characters; must not contain ' " ₩ / & ` or spaces

cloudHadoopClusterName.description: Cluster name (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, '-'; starts with a letter, ends with a letter or number)

cloudHadoopImageProductCode.description: Image product code (from ncloud_hadoop_list_image_products). Default: latest — explicit value recommended

engineVersionCode.description: Engine version code (for Rocky clusters). Not in the Financial-zone guide

kdcPassword.description: KDC admin password (required when useKdc=true; 8-20 chars, 9-20 in the Government zone)

loginKeyName.description: Login key name for SSH access

masterNodeDataStorageSize.description: Master storage GB (100-2000 in 10 GB steps, or 4000, 6000)

masterNodeDataStorageTypeCode.description: Master storage type: SSD | HDD (CB2 also in the Public zone)

useDataCatalog.description: Public zone only: use Data Catalog for the Hive metastore (default: false)

workerNodeDataStorageSize.description: Worker storage GB (100-2000 in 10 GB steps, or 4000, 6000)

workerNodeDataStorageTypeCode.description: Worker storage type: SSD | HDD (CB2 also in the Public zone)

name: ncloud_hadoop_create_cluster
